Lumen in Füssen

** Discover the magical world of **Lumen in Füssen**—where the fairy-tale charm of the **Alps** meets breathtaking light art. Every evening, the historic **Füssen** town center transforms into a mesmerizing canvas of colors and stories, guided by the gentle glow of **Lumen**. ### **A Journey Through Light and Legends** From **June to October**, immerse yourself in an enchanting experience that blends **Tirol’s** rich heritage with modern creativity. The illuminated paths weave through cobblestone streets, past the majestic **Hohenschwangau Castle** and the serene **Forgensee Lake**, inviting you to explore the region’s most captivating tales. ### **Highlights of the Light Experience** - **The Castle Trail**: Walk along the illuminated paths leading to **Hohenschwangau Castle**, where the legends of **King Ludwig II** come to life. - **The Lake of the Swans**: A dreamy reflection of light on **Forgensee Lake**, framed by the silhouette of **Neuschwanstein Castle** in the distance. - **The Town Square**: A vibrant spectacle of light and sound, celebrating **Füssen’s** history and culture. - **The Alpine Panorama**: A breathtaking view of the **Tirolian** mountains, bathed in a soft, ethereal glow. ### **Culinary Delights & Local Flavors** After your light adventure, indulge in **Tirolian** specialties at one of **Füssen’s** cozy restaurants. Try the fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork), or a hearty **Käsespätzle**—all paired with a crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of local **Apfelwein**. ### **Practical Information** - **When?** Daily from **June to October**, starting at **8:00 PM** (earlier in summer). - **Where?** **Füssen** town center, near **Hohenschwangau Castle** and **Forgensee Lake**. - **Duration:** Approximately **60–90 minutes** (self-guided or with an audio tour). - **Tickets:** Available online or at the **Tourist Information Füssen**. ### **Plan Your Visit** Combine your **Lumen** experience with a visit to **Neuschwanstein Castle** or a relaxing stroll along the **Lech River**. Whether you're a family, a couple, or a solo traveler, **Lumen in Füssen** promises an unforgettable evening under the stars. **More Information & Tickets**
